name: Tsu Contact
tagline: Offline Windows tool that converts CSV contact lists into vCard (.vcf) files ready to import into phones.
description: Tsu Contact is a desktop app (Python + Qt for Python/PySide6, Apache-2.0) that turns a CSV export from Excel, Google Contacts or a phone book into vCard 3.0 files. It auto-maps columns, detects encodings (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1258) and delimiters, normalizes Vietnamese phone numbers (+84, leading zeros lost by Excel, several numbers per cell), flags duplicates and invalid rows, and shows a searchable preview before export. It runs fully offline: the Qt network module is excluded from the build, there is no telemetry or update check, and contact data stays in memory. Windows releases are built only by GitHub Actions from version tags: a per-user Inno Setup installer (no admin rights, standard uninstall) and a portable zip. Every release ships a CycloneDX SBOM, a Sigstore-signed SHA256SUMS, SLSA build provenance (gh attestation verify) and VirusTotal reports. Code signing policy: https://contact.tsudev.com/code-signing-policy/
